_comment: Tunables for heatmap_bot.py (3-layer Bybit liquidity/liquidation service). Every key can be overridden by the matching HEATMAP_* env var (env wins). The tracked universe is the fixed HEATMAP_SYMBOLS list from bot/.env.heatmap; leave `symbols` empty here unless pinning it in this file.

_layers.1_orderbook: Observable order-book resting liquidity. WS L2 book, binned around mid, with a lifetime filter (ob_min_lifetime_seconds) to drop spoof levels.
_layers.2_actual: Real Bybit allLiquidation prints (ground truth). Stored as events.
_layers.3_predictive: Coinglass-style estimate: per candle, dOI sizes new notional, split long/short by taker-imbalance proxy, spread over leverage buckets; liq prices off MARK price; cohorts decay on dOI<0 and are consumed when mark price crosses them. Computed per timeframe.
_layers.4_volume_profile: Buy/sell (delta) volume profile from the publicTrade stream (taker buy vs sell notional per geometric price bin, hourly buckets). Seeded from klines (total only). Windows: rolling 4h/24h/7d + session-anchored daily/weekly. Yields POC, value area, HVNs, and delta-dominant long/short levels.

_fields.leverages: Leverage buckets for the predictive model.
_fields.leverage_weights: Relative weight per bucket (normalized). Must match leverages length.
_fields.maintenance_margin_rate: Approx maintenance margin used in the liq-price formula.
_fields.use_open_interest: true = size new positions from dOI (preferred); false = use candle turnover.
_fields.ob_min_lifetime_seconds: Order-book levels younger than this are treated as spoof and excluded.
